summary: Root-cause phase complete; no files changed. Branch feat/phase-9-supervised-tools at 9a7734460dded5469acd5e746f3118c9e3d28054; worktree clean. Root causes: (1) AgentSprite.tsx:79-82 spreads color onto SVG rect instead of fill, causing default opaque black and lost alpha; PNG import also drops alpha at App.tsx:3754-3762. (2) The same compositor can paint dense or transparent document cells as a black 64x64 square; editor-only square candidates are App.tsx:3560-3561 and App.css:487-493/1603-1611. Tauri/CSS overlay transparency is configured correctly at overlays.rs:195-202 and App.css:36-42/1392-1410. (3) Pencil mutates layer.pixels in place at App.tsx:3651-3673; visible preview corruption is amplified by (1). Preview reloads JSON independently, with no shared ImageData buffer found. (4) Selection uses the existing selection rectangle as its anchor at App.tsx:3609-3620; pointer-down only resets strokeRef at 4072-4076, so repeated and reverse drags lose the true anchor. (5) ConversationList markup at App.tsx:1139-1191 has no matching global .conversation-list styling; CSS import and Vite/Tauri packaging paths are present, so this is a selector omission, not a stylesheet packaging failure. Smallest fixes: explicit alpha-aware SVG fill, immutable active-layer updates, a stable pointer-down anchor helper/ref, and scoped conversation-list CSS plus accessible input labeling. Acceptance: preserve transparent sprites, remove visible square, isolate Pencil edits, pass arbitrary/reverse/repeated/clamped selection cases, restore styled accessible conversation controls, and preserve Phase 7-13 behavior. After implementation run focused editor/sprite/selection/conversation tests, then format, secrets, lint, typecheck, full tests, build, Python, Rust/Tauri, CI, and installed-Windows visual smoke.
